summary: Iteration 93 - Booking Engine Admin Panel Testing Complete. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Admin panel loads from sidebar 'Booking Engine' button, shows 3 tabs (Room Photos, Guest Reviews, Theme & Branding), booking URL displayed in green info bar with copy button, Preview button opens public booking page. Room Photos tab shows cards per room type with main photo and gallery sections. Guest Reviews tab has full CRUD (Add Review dialog with name/country/rating/title/comment/date, delete works). Theme tab has accent color picker with hex input and preview swatch, hero image URL with live preview, tagline and subtitle inputs, Save button persists config to public booking page.
